content.short: Takenos is a Latin American wallet for freelancers to receive global income and spend or withdraw locally.
content.description: Takenos is a financial app for Latin American freelancers and small businesses that lets them receive international income and spend or withdraw it locally without commission fees. Users get paid from clients and platforms abroad, hold a digital dollar account, and cash out to local currency or spend with the TakeCard, along with local payment options like QR and investment packages. Built on stablecoin infrastructure over Solana, with support for withdrawing USDT across networks, Takenos bridges on-chain payouts with everyday money for the region's remote workers who earn in dollars. It targets people facing slow, expensive traditional cross-border payment options who want a fast, low-cost way to get paid and use their money at home.
content.meta: Takenos lets LatAm freelancers receive global income and cash out locally. Discover Takenos and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
